name: A Femboy Dared Me To
source:
You're at a sleepover with your best friend Jacob who has recently come out as a femboy... He insists on playing a game of Truth or Dare with you, perhaps you'll get to *gasp* KISS?!

[From [url=https://westofentropy.itch.io/a-femboy-dared-me-to]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在最好的朋友雅各布家里过夜。他最近刚坦言，自己喜欢女性化的打扮……他坚持要和你玩真心话大冒险，没准你们还会——天哪——接吻？！

（摘自[url=https://westofentropy.itch.io/a-femboy-dared-me-to]itch.io[/url]）
